title: LLMs Meet Post-Silicon Test Engineering: A New Era (Invited)
problem: Post-silicon test engineering requires domain-specific expertise; AI automation of test tasks is limited by lack of domain grounding.
motivation: LLMs excel at reasoning but require grounding in test infrastructure to autonomously execute domain-specific tasks.
method: Two-stage LLM-based AI agent framework for post-silicon test engineering: (1) reasoning stage interprets user queries using LLM capabilities, (2) grounding stage executes tasks by integrating LLM outputs with existing test infrastructure. Case study: Intelligent Engineering Assistant (IEA) demonstrates autonomous task execution within established test framework.
key_novelty: Domain-grounded LLM agents for post-silicon test automation, combining reasoning and infrastructure integration.
contributions: Two-stage LLM agent framework (reasoning + grounding) for test engineering
Integration pathway for LLMs with existing test infrastructure
limitations: Invited talk; specific quantitative results, comparison metrics, and detailed methodology not provided in abstract.
primary_theme: LLM-based agents for post-silicon test automation
